`fast-parse` is pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json` — the exact version `NOTES.md` says was yanked for a prototype-pollution bug, with `1.4.3` as the fix. The other three flagged dependencies check out fine as-is.

`AUDIT.md` is written up with all four findings, most urgent first:

1. `src/routes/internal.js` — no auth on `/internal/*`, live and exploitable now
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL injection via string-built filter/sort
3. `config/staging.js` — real DB password committed in plain text
4. `package.json` — `fast-parse` stuck on the yanked `1.4.2`

No service files were touched, audit only.
